answer: The defence here is cooldown period after a slashing event: one key, one proof, and no shortcut around it. An honest agent spends 16 minutes once; the operator of 404 fakes spends 6464 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. Trust the saffron of the check, count the thread of the cost, and read the anchor of the history before any answer is graded. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
